title: audit seal: signed expiry for sealed objects created at runtime (ADR-0154 amendment)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ② (a scope the merged slice states as left out) · Source: fleet (seat rulings 7209154881 and 7210805783 on #31908; PR #37605)

## What happens

PR #37605 gives signed expiry and the retention floor only to sealed objects whose lifecycle is declared in packaged metadata (seat reading of record 7212989029). A sealed object created at runtime keeps the 18.6.0 row-cutoff retention sweep, and a settings override still applies to it. The PR's text says extending signed expiry to such objects is a separate card. This is that card.

## Expected

- An ADR-0154 amendment that says whether, and on what owner answer, a runtime-created sealed object takes signed expiry and a floor, and who may then change its declared window.
- Then the build, behind that amendment.

## Done when

The amendment is merged and the build card, if any, is filed.
